summaries.summary: Marco Rubio arrives in India for a three-day visit, with discussions on trade deals and energy supply diversification on the agenda.
Yelp introduces new AI features in its app, enabling it to call restaurants on users' behalf to check wait times and provide personalized recommendations.
Otter.ai secures $320 million in funding to enhance its meeting tool and expand internationally, while Flipkart quietly builds a food delivery service in India.
The custody of two CJP leaders is extended by an Executive Magistrate amid accusations of state-sponsored terrorism by Mamata Banerjee.
A tragic incident involving a fan of actor Tiger Shroff occurred during a firing incident, drawing attention to the Bollywood-underworld relationship.
An individual in Gujarat jumps off a cliff while advocating for changes to domestic violence laws and documenting his distress.
The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement officially comes into effect, introducing new visa categories and zero-duty access for Indian exports.
The latest campaign of Modern Warfare 4 receives enthusiastic responses from players on Steam, highlighting its popularity in the gaming community.
